courses.summary: 伊佐特地下天然氣儲存是本課引用官方資料的真實工程背景。研究焦點為鄰近儲存站之間共同調度與能力互補；課程把公開可確認的地理與項目身分，和自行建立的物料、能量、庫存及故障診斷情境分開，要求學徒逐項提交計算、假設、驗證資料與適用範圍。
courses.summaryEn: Izaute Storage is the real engineering context identified by the official source. The study focuses on joint scheduling and complementary capability between neighbouring storage sites, separating verified project identity and geography from authored material, energy, inventory and diagnostic scenarios. Learners submit calculations, assumptions, validation evidence and applicability limits.
